subject: Appointments and Approvals, Senior Judges and Plan B Judges
description: Order Approving Senior Judge [Janet S. Holcomb]
title: Oregon Supreme Court Order 2012-079 — Order Approving Senior Judge [Janet S. Holcomb]
text:
IN THE SUPREME COURT OF THE STATE OF OREGON
In the Matter of the Approval of
JANET S. HOLCOMB as a Senior Judge in
the STATE OF OREGON
IT HEREBY IS ORDERED that
JANET S. HOLCOMB
NO. 12-079
ORDER APPROVING
SENIOR JUDGE
is approved as Senior Judge in the State of Oregon pursuant to ORS 1.300(1 ), effective
December 1, 2012.
DATED this 151
h day of November 2012.
TL=C.eL Thomas A Balmer
Chief Justice
